model.description:
The {@link DiagramParsingMlModel} to use for diagram parsing. If this is not provided,
{@link modelBuildSpec} will be used to create a new model.

modelBuildSpec.description:
A spec for creating a new {@link DiagramParsingMlModel}. This field is ignored if
{@link model} is provided. If neither {@link model} nor {@link modelBuildSpec} is provided,
a default spec will be automatically created as follows:
```py
model_build_spec = c3.DiagramParsingModelBuildSpec(
    symbolDetectionPipe=c3.DiagramParsingSetupUtils.createTwoStageSymbolDetectionPipeTemplate()
).withDefaults()
```

matchingPipe.description: A template pipeline to match parsed entities against their targets.

diagrams.description:
A list of {@link SourceParsableDiagram}s to {@link SourceParsableDiagram#parseAndMatchBatch}.
This field is ignored by {@link DiagramParsingMatchingHelper#parseAndMatch}.
This field is ignored if `parsableDiagrams` field is provided.

parsableDiagrams.description:
A list of {@link ParsableDiagram}s to be parsed by the parsing job. This field
will take precedence over `diagrams` field.
i.e. if both are provided, then the specified {@link ParsableDiagram}s will be parsed.

dpi.description: The number of pixels per inch used by {@link PdfToImagePipe} to convert pdfs to images.

targetsToMatch.description: The {@link Sensor}s we want to match the parsed results to.

minMatchingScore.description: The minimum similarity score to consider a match

dropMultipleMatches.description: Whether to drop a single {@link ParsedSensor} if it matches multiple {@link Sensor}s

processJobOptions.description:
The {@link MlSubject.OperationJobSpec} for the underlying
{@link MlSubject.ProcessJob} triggered by the parsing workflow.

batchSize.description:
The batch size to use for running {@link ParsableDiagram#processBatch}, which is
the number of pages from the original pdf files to process per batch.

title:
Type to hold information necessary to run {@link SourceParsableDiagram#parseAndMatch}
or {@link SourceParsableDiagram#parseAndMatchBatch}.
name: DiagramParsingMatchingSpec
